correctness.evidence: Seven exact real-model cases per arm, 103,360 retained scores in each arm, legacy BOS, cache and output checks. Two/four component variants passed both reference widths, stalls and reset.

limitations: RTL cycle observations cover the seven fixed cases. Conversion at 50 MHz is analytical.
The two and four-lane variants include row-interleaved weight banks. Physical timing, resource inference and energy require separate evidence.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Autonomous first/last/done counters and simulated core-phase windows.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact archived output, score and valid cache fixtures for all three arms.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Pinned model loaded and legacy BOS run before the tested request

quality.evidence: Same frozen model, arithmetic and output encoding across tested cases.
